name: Anchors bound to barred identities
statement: An account is a member while it is bound as the anchor of an agent identity that the source list names, and that identity names the account as its owner or wallet.

dimensions.proposition: The account is the bound anchor of a listed identity
dimensions.source: The anchor registry and the identity registry the relation source is configured with

dimensions.proposition: The identity is a member of the source list
dimensions.source: The source list, at its latest state

extension.direction: From the listed agent identity to the account bound to it
extension.evidence: Two acts, one by each side: the account bound itself to the identity, and the identity names the account as owner or wallet. A statement by one side alone, such as naming a successor, establishes nothing.
